nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How much REEs/C was used in the experiment with the actual mine wastewater?
nodes.answer: In the experiment with mine wastewater, 0.1 g of REEs/C was used.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land degradation control|Rehabilitation of mining sites_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What ecological restoration technologies are mentioned for mine areas?
nodes.answer: The ecological restoration technologies mentioned include physical, chemical, and biological treatment strategies, notably phytoremediation.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Land degradation control|Rehabilitation of mining sites_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What was the purpose of the removal experiment involving REEs/C in mine wastewater?
nodes.answer: The purpose was to test the potential of REEs/C for practical applications in removing heavy metals from mine wastewater.
